answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Grading happens by lottery quorum: 7 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 66 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and one honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal. A single honest juror can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A falcon of doubt is healthy, a reef of proof is required, and a beacon of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
